一个独立的多棋种 AI 走子服务。请求携带当前局面，响应只返回最佳落子—— 不建: A standalone multi-game AI move service. Requests carry the current position; responses return only the best move — no games created, no game records stored, no sessions kept. Seven games, one API.
棋盘和棋谱由调用方持有；服务端只负责在当前局面下计算下一步。: The caller owns the board and game record; the server only computes the next move for the current position.
提交当前棋盘，直接返回最终走法、评估和搜索信息。: Submit the current board and get back the final move, evaluation, and search info.
按迭代加深层推送深度、节点数、评分和当前最佳走法，高难度时可观察进度。: Push depth, nodes, evaluation, and the current best move per iterative-deepening layer, so progress is visible at higher difficulty.
查询指定局面的全部合法走法，供前端落点提示或规则校验使用。: Query every legal move for a given position, for frontend move hints or rule validation.
同一套请求结构；点击棋种查看规则、坐标和初始局面。: One request structure; click a game for its rules, coordinates, and initial position.
标准 FIDE 规则，王车易位、吃过路兵、升变全部支持。: Standard FIDE rules, with castling, en passant, and promotion all supported.
白方先行，目标是将死对方王。: White moves first; the goal is to checkmate the opposing king.
王车易位要求王与车均未移动、之间无子、王不在被将军状态且经过的格子不受攻击。: Castling requires that neither king nor rook has moved, that no pieces stand between them, that the king is not in check, and that the squares it passes through are not attacked.
兵首次可前进两格；吃子斜走一格；到达底线必须升变为后、车、象或马。: A pawn may advance two squares on its first move, captures one square diagonally, and must promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight on reaching the last rank.
楚河汉界，车马炮全规则，将帅不可照面。: The Chu River and Han Border, full chariot, horse, and cannon rules, and the kings may not face each other.
红方先行，目标是将死对方将帅。: Red moves first; the goal is to checkmate the opposing king.
帅/将只能在九宫内横竖走一格；士/仕在九宫内斜走一格。: The king moves one square orthogonally inside the palace; the advisor moves one square diagonally inside the palace.
相/象走田字，不能过河；马走日字，蹩马腿时不能走。: The elephant moves two squares diagonally and may not cross the river; the horse moves in an L and is blocked when its leg is pinned.
15×15 自由规则，横竖斜先连成五子者胜。: 15×15 freestyle rules; the first to line up five horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
黑方先行，双方轮流在空交叉点落子。: Black moves first; players alternate placing stones on empty intersections.
横、竖、两条斜线任意方向先形成连续五子或更多的一方获胜。: The first player to form an unbroken line of five or more in any direction — horizontal, vertical, or either diagonal — wins.
棋盘填满仍未分胜负则为和棋。: If the board fills with no winner, the game is a draw.
重力落子，横竖斜先连成四子者胜。: Pieces drop with gravity; the first to line up four horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
红方先行，双方轮流选择一列落子，棋子落到该列最下方的空位。: Red moves first; players alternate choosing a column, and the piece drops to the lowest empty slot in that column.
任意方向（横、竖、两条斜线）先连成四子的一方获胜。: The first player to connect four in any direction (horizontal, vertical, or either diagonal) wins.
棋盘填满且无人连成四子则为和棋。: If the board fills with no four in a row, the game is a draw.
夹住对方棋子即可翻面，终局子多者胜。: Sandwich opponent discs to flip them; the player with more discs at the end wins.
黑方先行。落子后，在横、竖、斜任意方向夹住对方棋子，被夹住的棋子全部翻成己方颜色: Black moves first. A move flips every opponent disc sandwiched horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
必须至少翻转一枚对方棋子才能落子。: A move must flip at least one opponent disc.
一方无子可下时自动跳过，由另一方继续落子。: When a side has no legal move, its turn is skipped and the other side continues.
象狮虎豹狼狗猫鼠，踏入对方兽穴即胜。: Elephant, lion, tiger, leopard, wolf, dog, cat, rat; enter the opponent's den to win.
红方先行，每次将一枚兽横向或纵向移动一格，或吃子。: Red moves first; each turn, move one animal one square horizontally or vertically, or capture.
战力：象>狮>虎>豹>狼>狗>猫>鼠；鼠可吃象，象不能吃鼠。: Rank: elephant > lion > tiger > leopard > wolf > dog > cat > rat; the rat can capture the elephant, but the elephant cannot capture the rat.
鼠可入水，水中鼠不能被陆上兽吃；狮、虎可跳过整片水域，但水中有鼠时不能跳。: The rat can enter water, where land animals cannot capture it; the lion and tiger can jump across a whole stretch of water, but not while a rat is in it.
121 孔星形棋盘，十子归营，可连跳。: 121-hole star board; move all ten pieces home, with chain jumps.
红方先行，双方各 10 枚棋子，初始占据对顶的两个角。: Red moves first; each side has 10 pieces and starts in opposite corners.
每回合可将一枚棋子走到相邻空孔，或连续跳过相邻棋子落到空孔。: Each turn, move a piece to an adjacent empty hole, or make consecutive jumps over adjacent pieces into empty holes.
跳跃可以跨越任意颜色的棋子，被跨越的棋子不动，也不被吃掉。: Jumps may cross pieces of either color; jumped pieces stay put and are not captured.
当前局面进，下一步出。没有会话，也没有需要同步的棋局状态。: Position in, next move out. No sessions and no game state to sync.
返回棋盘尺寸、初始局面、规则和走子格式。: Returns the board size, initial position, rules, and move format.
